name: Health Care

features.text: Timed read-only clinical examinations with bounded, observer-scoped recent-observation reports.
Species-agnostic procedure reservations, resource locks, replay protection and uncertain-outcome inspection; MORTIS owns anatomy.
Timed corpse-part recovery with tool, clothing, anatomy and detached-part provenance checks.
Optional Spectrum cold-pack self-care uses native server timed actions, consumed supplies and canonical Spectrum receipts.
Optional independent Only Cure+ 3.2.0 capability detection and bounded local self-observation in historical examination reports; no foreign state writes.
Only Cure+ clinical/prosthetic mutation and remote observations require authority, privacy and anatomy-ownership contracts.

limits: Development source 0.12.0. Only Cure+ native SP/split-screen/hosted/dedicated coexistence NOT TESTED; no remote or treatment bridge. G7 and stable G8 BLOCKED. Knowledge & Wisdom 0.16.0 dedicated storage unavailable. Last distributed Health Care version is 0.10.1.

relations.text: Consumes canonical Spectrum sunburn treatment/receipt capability when available; Spectrum retains dose ownership.
